method_card.objective: Acquire the exact open article original for reading at a specific body location.
method_card.mechanism: Supply candidates.json from scholarly-search@1 and parameter pmcid (one of its fetchable_pmcids). Transfer the original Europe PMC JATS bytes and compare the embedded article accession to the selected identifier. Read the acquired paper with gx_read_source.
method_card.estimator: article.xml is the original article. acquisition.json records PMCID, source URL, retrieval time and a content-addressed version for the exact bytes.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Europe PMC and Crossref public metadata and Open Access JATS terms; intake records retain original source rights.
manifest.limitations: Requires accessible open JATS with a body and matching accession. An abstract-only hit or a provider error cannot supply the original.
